port_difficulty.why: One CICS READ into a copybook record and a RETURN, with no arithmetic or branching. The only care is decoding the packed decimal ACCT-BAL and the display key ACCT-ID.

blast_radius.why: Read-only against the ACCTDAT file and reversible by routing transaction TRNR back to the old program. A wrong decode of ACCT-BAL would be silent, but nothing in the tree consumes what it reads.

units.driving_fact: Reads the ACCTDAT file that PROGW writes, with the same ACCTREC layout on both sides.

port_difficulty.why: One CICS WRITE from a copybook record and a RETURN, with no arithmetic or branching. The port is plumbing. The packed decimal ACCT-BAL is written as is, and neither program moves a value into ACCT-ID or ACCT-BAL, so what it writes cannot be derived from the source.

blast_radius.why: Writes the account balance record to a VSAM KSDS, a system of record, and a write cannot be rolled back by rerouting the transaction. A layout or packed decimal error is silent. Any nightly batch reader or writer of the same file is outside the tree, so the score could be 5.

units.driving_fact: The only writer of the ACCTDAT file in the tree, and the nightly batch cycle that must not break is not in the tree, so its use of this file is unknown.
